benchmark_metadata.model_compatibility_note: Uses OpenVLCLIP v0.7.0's processor-aware NaFlex inputs, retaining pixel_attention_mask and spatial_shapes; Japanese retrieval is exploratory.
benchmark_metadata.dataset_license: The official University of Toronto page publishes the Python archive and requests citation of the dataset technical report; no separate acceptance agreement is displayed. This benchmark performs evaluation only and does not redistribute the archive.
benchmark_metadata.training_data_overlap_risk: The model pretraining corpus is not independently verified to exclude this evaluation dataset; training-data contamination cannot be ruled out.
